items.reason: The restart guard fails to recognize SpawnProcess workers, leaving hung workers alive when replacements start.
The docstring incorrectly promises one process per shard despite capped workers sharing shards.
The wait_produce metric uses 'shards' instead of the sibling metrics' 'shard' tag.
Breaking out when the join deadline expires skips termination of remaining workers.
The wait_produce metric's 'shards' tag disagrees with the 'shard' tag used by sibling metrics.
The test's monkeypatch makes the added time.sleep(0.1) a no-op, so it provides no synchronization.
The added delay cannot synchronize the flusher because time.sleep is monkeypatched to return immediately.

The comment includes the inadequate shard-total assertion and requests checking actual assignment without duplicates, covering the golden issue. It additionally requests balanced distribution and flushing coverage.
The multiprocessing.Process type check excludes SpawnProcess workers, preventing hung workers from being killed before replacement.
The restart guard excludes SpawnProcess instances, allowing the original worker and its replacement to handle the same shards.
The deadline-triggered break skips termination of remaining flusher processes during shutdown.
